fix: Write the recursion straight into the output instead of building an intermediate list and cloning it: change `fn lift_partitions_in(commands: &[PaintCommand]) -> Self` to `fn lift_partitions_into(commands: &[PaintCommand], out: &mut Self)`, push base commands into `out`, collect nested lifted entries in a local `lifted: Self` and finish with `out.commands_mut().append(lifted.commands_mut());`, and replace this line with `lift_partitions_into(&commands[start + 1..end], &mut entry);`. Removes one Vec allocation and a clone of every nested command per partition per frame.

The lifted entries are owned and only appended, so move them instead of cloning every command: `base.commands_mut().append(lifted.commands_mut());` (with `lifted` as one `Self`/`Vec<PaintCommand>` accumulator, see the preceding finding). Clones each lifted command a second time per frame otherwise.

Avoid a heap allocation on every call: use an inline small stack, e.g. `let mut transforms: smallvec::SmallVec<[Transform; 8]> = smallvec::smallvec![Transform::IDENTITY];` (smallvec is already a workspace dependency, root Cargo.toml line 84; add `smallvec = { workspace = true }` to crates/incular-rendering/Cargo.toml if missing). Only translations reach the stack, so the depth check stays unchanged. Confirm the call frequency before merging, since the finding is high only if this runs per frame.

The parent list holds at most `self.len()` commands, so reserve once instead of growing by doubling: `let mut parent = Self::new(); parent.reserve_total(self.len());` (reserve_total is the existing pub(crate) helper). Applies to every frame that contains a popup.

`Canvas` is re-exported by the `incular` facade, so an app author's unmatched `restore()` panics. Either return a structured error: `pub fn try_restore(&mut self) -> Result<(), UnbalancedCanvas>` (with `UnbalancedCanvas` a small error type in this crate) plus `restore` documented with `# Panics` as the contract wrapper; or document `# Panics` on `restore` and add the `try_restore` pair per CONTRIBUTING.md. Replace the `expect` with `let Some(kind) = self.saves.pop() else { return Err(UnbalancedCanvas) };` in the try form.

Public `Canvas::finish` panics on app-author input (a save without a matching restore). Add a `# Panics` section to its doc comment and a `try_finish(self) -> Result<DisplayList, UnbalancedCanvas>` form that returns the error, with `finish` delegating to it and calling `expect` on the error; or return the error only from `try_finish`.

Panics when the last command is an unmatched `PushSurfacePartition`: `index` reaches `len`, so `end == start == len - 1` and `commands[start + 1..end]` is an inverted range. Track whether the partition closed: `let closed = index < commands.len(); let inner_end = index.min(commands.len());` then slice `&commands[start + 1..inner_end]`, and append `PopSurfacePartition` only when `closed`. (Marker pairing is a framework invariant, so this is a latent panic, not an app-author error.)
